content: {"reasoning":"The claim remains denied for missing required authorization despite submission with records and a medical-necessity appeal; silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. No claim-data error or information request supports another rework action. CO-197 assigns contractual responsibility to the provider, so the denied balance cannot properly be transferred to the patient merely because deductible and coinsurance apply to covered claims; with no supported collection path remaining, write off the balance.","action":"write_off"}
